floater.name: sl_pose_studio
floater.title: Pose Studio
floater.string: Not posing. Press Pose to start.
Posing. Pick a bone, then turn the dials.
They need to be in this region with you.
They already let you pose them; pick them under Posing.
You asked them less than a minute ago.
The helper is starting; try again in a few seconds.
The helper cannot run here (no scripts, or RLV).
RLV does not let you send pose requests right now.
Request sent. When they accept, pick them under Posing.
Sending ([MAP]); not looking at anything right now.
Not sending yet: waiting for the helper object.
Not sending: RLV restricts the pose channel.
Not sending: "Disable Look At Animation" is on.
Not sending: your AO keeps your head still (AO option "Keep head still").

combo_box.name: target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Who to pose: yourself, an animated object you own, or someone who accepted your request (Pose other...)

button.label: Pose
button.name: pose_btn
button.tool_tip: Start or stop posing the selected avatar. Posing is local: only you see it unless you share it.

combo_box.name: figure_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Bone picker figure: human or pony / quadruped

combo_box.name: view_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which part of the figure to show: body, hands, face, tail and wings

sl_pose_figure.name: figure
sl_pose_figure.tool_tip: Click a dot to pick a bone. Blue dots are edited bones -- the ones a save writes and sharing sends; grey ones are not in this skeleton.

button.label: Stop being posed
button.name: stop_posed_btn
button.tool_tip: End every pose request you accepted. Everyone stops seeing you posed.

sl_pose_dial.label: X
sl_pose_dial.name: dial_x
sl_pose_dial.tool_tip: X, as on the OP Pose HUD (head: tilt along the nose). Click the hub or the knob to reset to 0.

sl_pose_dial.label: Y
sl_pose_dial.name: dial_y
sl_pose_dial.tool_tip: Y, as on the OP Pose HUD (head: nod; legs: swing forward and back). Click the hub or the knob to reset to 0.

sl_pose_dial.label: Z
sl_pose_dial.name: dial_z
sl_pose_dial.tool_tip: Z, as on the OP Pose HUD (head: turn side to side). Click the hub or the knob to reset to 0.

spinner.name: spin_x
spinner.tool_tip: X in degrees (OP Pose HUD numbers)

spinner.name: spin_y
spinner.tool_tip: Y in degrees (OP Pose HUD numbers)

spinner.name: spin_z
spinner.tool_tip: Z in degrees (OP Pose HUD numbers)

combo_box.name: snap_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Off (default): dials move smoothly at full precision. Or round drags to a step; Bone uses each bone's OP Pose HUD step.

check_box.label: Mirror
check_box.name: mirror_check
check_box.tool_tip: Posing one limb also poses the opposite one, mirrored across the spine

check_box.label: Freeze
check_box.name: freeze_check
check_box.tool_tip: Hold every bone still. Untick to let your animations keep playing on the bones you have not changed.

button.label: Undo
button.name: undo_btn
button.tool_tip: Undo the last change to this bone, or the last IK handle drag (every bone it moved)

button.label: Redo
button.name: redo_btn
button.tool_tip: Redo the last undone change to this bone, or IK handle drag

button.label: Reset bone
button.name: reset_bone_btn
button.tool_tip: Put this bone back (and its mirror partner, in mirror mode)

button.label: Reset all
button.name: reset_all_btn
button.tool_tip: Put every bone back

check_box.label: IK handles
check_box.name: ik_check
check_box.tool_tip: Show IK handles on the avatar you are posing. Drag a cone to move a hand, foot or the head (it stays where you drop it; Shift: along one axis); Ctrl+drag turns it, Ctrl+Shift+drag rolls it. Click a cone to select it: its arrows and squares move it along an axis or plane; hold Ctrl for rotate rings. Drag the small diamond at an elbow or knee to aim it, the big one at the hips to move the body. Right-click a cone to pin it in place. Undo takes back a whole drag.

button.label: Unpin
button.name: ik_unpin_btn
button.tool_tip: Release every pinned IK handle

button.label: Snap
button.name: ik_snap_btn
button.tool_tip: Put every IK handle (and elbow / knee pole) back on its bones as they are now

button.label: Export
button.name: export_btn
button.tool_tip: Open your poses folder; pose files are plain XML you can copy and share

button.label: Pose other...
button.name: pose_other_btn
button.tool_tip: Ask someone nearby to let you pose them. They get a dialog in any viewer; once they accept, pick them under Posing.

button.label: Release
button.name: release_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop posing everyone and let your animations take over again

spinner.label: Ease
spinner.name: edit_ease_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds a bone change eases in over instead of snapping (0 = at once): typed or stepped dial values, undo / redo. Dragging a dial or IK handle follows the mouse. Shared poses send it, so other Slipstream viewers see the same ease.

check_box.label: Share my pose with Slipstream users nearby
check_box.name: share_check
check_box.tool_tip: Show your pose to other Slipstream users nearby who have 'Show poses' on. Uses a small helper object (#GunMetal-DX Helper) while sharing.

check_box.label: Show poses other Slipstream users share
check_box.name: show_others_check
check_box.tool_tip: See the poses other Slipstream users share with you (uses a small helper object while on)

combo_box.name: synced_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: People whose shared poses you see, people you ignore, and people whose pose requests you blocked

button.label: Ignore
button.name: ignore_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop showing (or show again) this person's shared poses; for someone whose pose requests you blocked, allow their requests again

button.label: Classic...
button.name: classic_btn
button.tool_tip: Open the classic poser (BVH export, hand presets, 3D gizmo)

button.label: Creator...
button.name: creator_btn
button.tool_tip: Pose Creator: capture keyframes of this pose and make an animation (.anim) to upload

scroll_list.name: pose_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Your saved poses (also the classic poser's). Double-click to load.

line_editor.name: pose_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Name to save the pose under

spinner.label: Ease in (s)
spinner.name: save_ease_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Saved with the pose: how long playing it blends from the current pose into it (0 = snap)

button.label: Add to sequence
button.name: add_seq_btn
button.tool_tip: Append the selected pose to the sequence, held for the time set on the right

button.name: prev_btn
button.tool_tip: Previous pose

button.name: play_btn
button.tool_tip: Play the sequence

button.name: stop_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop playing

button.name: next_btn
button.tool_tip: Next pose

check_box.label: Loop
check_box.name: loop_check
check_box.tool_tip: Start over after the last pose

spinner.label: Hold
spinner.name: hold_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds to hold the selected pose (also used for poses you add)

button.name: seq_up_btn
button.tool_tip: Move up

button.name: seq_down_btn
button.tool_tip: Move down

button.label: Remove
button.name: seq_remove_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected pose from the sequence

spinner.label: Ease
spinner.name: seq_ease_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Ease-in for the selected sequence step, in seconds; -1 uses the pose file's own

check_box.label: Send where I look
check_box.name: lookat_send_check
check_box.tool_tip: Other Slipstream users with 'Show look-at' on see your mesh body turn its own neck and head (pony, Bento neck, human) toward what you look at, even over animations. Sends a direction only, never what you look at. Cannot be switched on while 'Don't send my Look At target to others' (Preferences, Privacy) is on; nothing is sent while your AO holds your head either. Uses the small helper object while on.

check_box.label: Show look-at
check_box.name: lookat_show_check
check_box.tool_tip: Turn other Slipstream users' heads by the look-at they send (needs 'Show poses' on). A bone that a Pose Studio pose holds keeps the pose.

check_box.label: Show mine on me
check_box.name: lookat_self_check
check_box.tool_tip: While sending, turn your own avatar's head the same way here, so you see what others see

combo_box.name: lookat_map_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which bones turn your head (sent with your look-at). Auto: the Pose Studio figure you picked, else what your worn meshes are rigged to, else Human. The maps are in app_settings/posestudio/lookat_maps.xml.

spinner.label: Strength
spinner.name: lookat_strength_spin
spinner.tool_tip: How far your head turns toward what you look at (sent with your look-at)

spinner.label: Limits
spinner.name: lookat_limit_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Scales how far each neck and head bone may turn, for the avatars you see

spinner.label: Ease
spinner.name: lookat_ease_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds a head takes to settle onto a new look-at target and to fade in or out, for you and for the people you see (0 = no easing). Sent with your look-at, so others see your preference.

combo_box.name: lookat_people_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: People whose look-at you see, and the ones you muted

button.label: Mute
button.name: lookat_mute_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop (or start again) turning this person's head by their look-at

floater.text: "Send where I look" needs "Don't send my Look At target to others" off (Preferences > Privacy).
